item.title: ZEV mandate explained: UK targets, rules and flexibilities
item.description: What is the ZEV mandate? The UK regulation requiring car manufacturers to sell increasing percentages of electric vehicles until 2035. Here's how it works.

item.title: Renault Filante covers 1,000km at motorway speed on a single charge
item.description: The purpose-built demonstrator used an 87kWh battery - the same size as the Scenic E-Tech - to travel 1,008km at an average of 102km/h, consuming just 7.8kWh per 100km. Renault says the findings will inform future production EVs.

item.title: Germany's planned truck charging network would need 22 hours of daily use by 2040
item.description: A new study commissioned by the German Hydrogen Association finds that electrifying all long-haul trucks would require 8GW of midday charging power - far exceeding planned infrastructure capacity. It argues hydrogen could ease grid pressure.

item.title: New hydrogen bus station for western Germany will fuel 25 vehicles per day
item.description: Cavendish Hydrogen has won a €4-5m contract to build a 350 bar refuelling station, with Everfuel as subcontractor. The same pairing built the Frankfurt and Wuppertal stations. Customer to be announced.

item.title: First electric truck crosses the Channel Tunnel on 1,700km UK to Germany run
item.description: A DAF XF Electric carried 12 tonnes of freight from the East Midlands to Haiger, Germany and back, charging at megawatt-speed in the UK and topping up at public hubs in France and Belgium. LeShuttle Freight says all eHGVs can use the tunnel later this year.

item.title: Mercedes-Benz NextGenH2 hydrogen truck enters limited production late 2026
item.description: Daimler Truck will build 100 liquid-hydrogen fuel cell trucks at Wörth from late 2026. Full series production has slipped to the early 2030s as infrastructure lags. The NextGenH2 shares components with the battery-electric eActros 600.

item.title: Gridserve opens UK's first public electric truck charging hubs on motorways
item.description: Gridserve has opened the UK's first public charging hubs for electric HGVs at Extra Baldock and Moto Exeter. The sites form part of the Electric Freightway programme backed by £62.7 million in government funding. Five more locations follow later this year.

item.title: UK government raises EV charger grants to £500 in final year of funding
item.description: UK EV charger grants rise to £500 from April 2026 for renters, flats and businesses. Final year of funding before scheme closes. Here's who qualifies.

item.title: Andersen EV and Octopus offer six months free home charging with new charger
item.description: Andersen EV offers six months of free charging through Intelligent Octopus Go for new charger customers, worth around £234 in electricity savings.

item.title: Land Rover Defender Sport EV to launch in 2027 with reduced off-road ability
item.description: Land Rover confirms the electric Defender Sport will launch in 2027 on JLR's EMA platform, smaller than the Defender 90 with reduced off-road capability.
